source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the third line of defence (PDF 175).

blocks.text: Kabhi kabhi microbes difa ki pehli aur doosri line ko paar kar lete hain. Jab aisa hota hai to unhein difa ki teesri line ka saamna karna parta hai. Teesri line immune system faraham karta hai. Yeh specific (makhsoos) difa hai, yaani yeh khaas jaraseem ko nishana banata hai aur khaas unhi ke khilaf kaam karta hai. Teesri line (immune system) pichhle hamla awaron ko yaad rakh sakti hai aur agar woh dobara jism mein aayen to tezi se jawab deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si do khoobiyan teesri line ko pehli do lines se alag karti hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh specific hai, yaani khaas jaraseem ko nishana banati hai; aur is mein memory (yaad) hai, is liye dobara aane wale jaraseem ko tezi se jawab deti hai.

items: Teesri line = immune system: specific difa.
Pichhle hamla awaron ko yaad rakhti hai aur dobara aane par tez jawab deti hai.
